name: Yavimaya
description: Yavimaya is a forested region of Dominaria, also tied to the ruins of Kroog.

description_citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 8" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2018.

summary.text: Yavimaya is a forested region of Dominaria, also tied to the ruins of Kroog.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 8" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2018.

bio.text: Baird said Jaya had gone toward Yavimaya looking for a friend.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 8" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2018.

bio.text: Chandra reached the coast across from Yavimaya, saw trees trembling and heard fighting there.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 8" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2018.
"Return to Dominaria: Episode 8" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2018.

status.text: The last event shows Chandra seeing trees trembling and hearing fighting in Yavimaya.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 8" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Fyndhorn is swallowed by the sea and refugees are led to Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: Fyndhorn was swallowed by the sea

citation.text: "Elf", section "Terisiaran Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza's Sylex Blast damages the plane and the sentient forest of Yavimaya traps Multani in its rift.
timeline.quote: instead causing Multani to become trapped in the rift.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Yavimayan rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Venser rescues Multani from the Yavimayan rift and Jeska seals it with Radha's spark, which burns out.
timeline.quote: Radha's spark burned out, causing the warlord to lose her potential to become a planeswalker.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Yavimayan rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaysa speaks as Elder Druid but Yavimaya recognizes only its own voice.
timeline.quote: Kaysa speaks as the Elder Druid, but the Yavimaya recognizes only one voice: its own.

citation.text: Kaysa (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Taaveti says the Fyndhorn orphans find no welcome in Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: "We orphans of Fyndhorn have found no welcome in this alien place."

citation.text: Yavimaya Ancients (Alliances, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Elves led by Kaysa and Jaeuhl escape to the Yavimaya forest.
timeline.quote: a convoy of Elves escape to the Yavimaya forest

citation.text: "Alliances (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Peace is made with the Yavimayan apes, the Elves settle, and Jaeuhl and Kaysa have a child.
timeline.quote: Jaeuhl and Kaysa have a child, and the Carthalion lineage continues

citation.text: "Alliances (comic)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza comes to Yavimaya for allies; Multani, knowing Urza destroyed Argoth, imprisons him in a living tree and makes him feel the land's pain.
timeline.quote: Multani used Yavimaya's magic to disorientate him, imprison him in a living tree, and make him feel the pain of the land

citation.text: "Multani", section "Timestreams". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sylex Blast cracks the Mori Tumulus with a rift.
timeline.quote: a 500 foot tall, 300 mile long ridge cracked by a rift formed by the Sylex Blast

citation.text: "Terisian Isles", section "Yavimaya". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Yavimaya Multani, remembering Argoth's devastation, ensorcells Urza in a tree for three years.
timeline.quote: Urza apologizes but is ensorcelled by Multani until he is encased in a tree

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani and Urza become allies and Yavimaya strengthens against Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: After this Multani and Urza became allies.

citation.text: "Multani", section "Bloodlines". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yavimaya recruits the elf Rofellos as a new avatar, but he cannot cope and Multani returns.
timeline.quote: Eventually, though, Rofellos couldn't cope with being the avatar of a living forest and Multani returned to take that place.

citation.text: "Multani", section "Bloodlines". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani traps Urza in a magnigoth tree at Yavimaya and forces him to feel Titania's pain.
timeline.quote: trapped Urza in a magnigoth tree and forced him to experience all the pain Titania

citation.text: "Urza", section "Atonement for Past Sins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rofellos arrives in Yavimaya to build its defenses and exchanges places with Multani as voice of the forest, freeing Multani to travel.
timeline.quote: he exchanged places with Multani as voice of Yavimaya, allowing Multani to go abroad in the world.

citation.text: "Yavimaya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza journeys to Yavimaya to enlist aid against the Phyrexians and is taken captive by Multani; his consciousness merges with the forest's for a time.
timeline.quote: Urza was then taken captive by the forest's emissary, Multani.

citation.text: "Yavimaya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion, Multani transplants part of Yavimaya to Urborg's edge for the last great battle.
timeline.quote: Multani transplanted part of Yavimaya to Urborg 's edge

citation.text: "Yavimaya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kavu emerge across Dominaria, the first and strongest from Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: Kavu emerged all across Dominaria, but the first and the strongest came from Yavimaya.

citation.text: Kavu Monarch (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Kavu erupt from the ground as Phyrexians fall from the sky.
timeline.quote: fountains of kavu erupted from the ground.

citation.text: Kavu Lair (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Darigaaz slays the rebellious dragon lord Rokun and throws his corpse onto the Magnigoth Tree, which frees Rith.
timeline.quote: Darigaaz slew the upstart, throwing his corpse onto the Magnigoth Tree.

citation.text: "Darigaaz", section "Freeing Rith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rith takes charge of the dragons and Darigaaz falls into line behind her.
timeline.quote: Darigaaz, awestruck, fell into line behind her leadership.

citation.text: "Darigaaz", section "Freeing Rith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Part of Yavimaya is displaced to Urborg during the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: During the third phase of the Phyrexian Invasion, part of Yavimaya was displaced to Urborg.

citation.text: "Elf", section "Yavimayan Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The enraged spirit of Multani casts out the Yavimayan elves.
timeline.quote: Cast out by the enraged spirit of Multani

citation.text: "Elf", section "Yavimayan Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Yavimayan exiles under Meria join the Coalition.
timeline.quote: they joined The Coalition against the Second Phyrexian Invasion

citation.text: "Elf", section "Yavimayan Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians in Yavimaya are killed and resurrected as woodmen fighting for the forest.
timeline.quote: the Phyrexians there are killed and resurrected as woodmen that fight for the forest.

citation.text: "Invasion (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Phyrexian invasion Multani senses Eladamri as the perfect leader and travels across the oceans to find him.
timeline.quote: that creature was Eladamri who was currently saving elves in Llanowar

citation.text: "Multani", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani transplants a section of Yavimaya and its defenders to Urborg, spending nearly all his power and disappearing.
timeline.quote: Multani transplanted a few miles of Yavimaya and several of its most powerful defenders to Urborg

citation.text: "Multani", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Under Leshrac's influence, Jeska uses Radha to seal the rift, costing Radha her potential to become a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Under the influence of Leshrac , Jeska used Radha to seal the rift, causing the warrior to lose her potential to become a planeswalker.

citation.text: "Yavimaya", section "Yavimayan rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani returns to Yavimaya, learns other lands have fallen, and transplants part of Yavimaya onto Urborg, driving Crovax from his throne room.
timeline.quote: He flees to regroup his army.

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani bonds Radha to Yavimaya, restoring her green mana, and Jeska uses her to close the Yavimaya rift.
timeline.quote: Jeska then used Radha again to close the rift in Yavimaya.

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kaysa sends Juniper Order druids to reclaim Yavimaya's borders from Heidar's second winter.
timeline.quote: Our border lands fall under the grip of Heidar's second winter.

citation.text: Into the North (Coldsnap, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Yavimayan shamans destroy the Phyrexians; Kjeldor and Yavimaya rout the cultists and a ritual ends the unnatural winter, restoring the Thaw.
timeline.quote: a Yavimayan ritual permanently ended Rimewind's unnatural winter and restored the Thaw to its proper course

citation.text: "Cult of Rimewind", section "The End of Rimewind". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Edahlis warns that slivers have taken Yavimaya and urges leaving for Skyshroud.
timeline.quote: Yavimaya is lost. We must leave now for Skyshroud.

citation.text: Firewake Sliver (Time Spiral, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: During the temporal crisis a rift in Yavimaya suspends Multani; he imprisons Venser in a tree to ask for help.
timeline.quote: Multani imprisoned Venser in a tree in a similar manner as with Urza long ago, to ask for help.

citation.text: "Multani", section "Temporal Crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani bonds Radha to the forest, restoring her green mana, and hypnotizes Jeska.
timeline.quote: He also created a new bond between Radha and the forest

citation.text: "Multani", section "Temporal Crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska awakens and blasts Multani's physical body to smithereens, then uses Radha and his mask to seal the rift, diminishing his essence.
timeline.quote: Jeska awakened and blasted Multani's physical body to smithereens.

citation.text: "Multani", section "Temporal Crisis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska burns out Radha's inherited spark, closing the Yavimaya rift but temporarily destroying Multani.
timeline.quote: burning out the spark Radha had unknowingly inherited

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Resolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi, Jhoira and Venser find Multani incapacitated by the Yavimaya rift.
timeline.quote: Venser can planeswalk into the rift and free Multani

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska seals the Yavimayan rift through Radha and Multani's mask, leaving the mask inert; Jhoira buries it.
timeline.quote: Jhoira buries Multani's mask in the hopes that he can someday be revived

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn tells of Yavimaya being aware but not always awake.
timeline.quote: "Yavimaya is aware, but not always awake.

citation.text: Sylvan Awakening (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sixty years after the Mending Multani awakens, and Chandra Nalaar restores him to consciousness.
timeline.quote: He was restored to consciousness by Chandra Nalaar

citation.text: "Multani", section "Return and offspring". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sixty years after the Mending, Multani's mind awakens in rage and Muldrotha is born on Urborg.
timeline.quote: his child Muldrotha was born into Yavimaya's offshoot on Urborg

citation.text: "Yavimaya", section "Revival". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cast out by Multani's raging spirit, the Yavimayan elves live as exiles.
timeline.quote: Cast out by the raging spirit of Multani, Yavimayan elves had to live as exiles on the outskirts of their former home.

citation.text: "Yavimaya", section "Revival". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Multani calms and the elves return to Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: Now that Multani has calmed, the elves are free to return to Yavimaya.

citation.text: "Yavimaya", section "Revival". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Baird says Jaya came looking for a friend and went toward Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: To the Yavimaya forest, I believe.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 8" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra reaches the coast across from Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: This had to be Yavimaya.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 8" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra sees trees trembling and hears fighting in Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: Suddenly a whole section of huge trees on an inland hillside rippled and trembled

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 8" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra finds giant automatons digging a crater.
timeline.quote: They were each around twenty feet high, with scoops for hands and big blocky heads.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 8" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Animated trees attack and tear apart an automaton.
timeline.quote: It leapt on the nearest automaton and ripped it apart.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 8" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2018.

timeline.summary: A small automaton warns Chandra that the trees attack any movement.
timeline.quote: Take care. They will attack any movement.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 8" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2018.

timeline.summary: The automaton says Multani animated the trees.
timeline.quote: They're animated trees, created and sent by Multani.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 8" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra burns a row of attacking trees.
timeline.quote: She reached a spot of higher ground where she had a better angle and sent a stream of fire down the whole row of trees.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 8" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Karn explains Multani is injured and acts out of instinct.
timeline.quote: Multani is an elemental, and has been in a semiconscious state

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 8" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Karn reveals he is the friend who has been gone a long time.
timeline.quote: I'm Karn. And I am someone who has been gone for a long time.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 8" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Mother Luti appears in Yavimaya and claims the goggles, revealing herself as Jaya.
timeline.quote: I believe those are mine.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 8" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Liliana, Jaya and Chandra discuss killing Belzenlok without the Chain Veil, and Liliana raises using the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: It's a sword that slew an elder dragon, and Gideon is too delicate to allow us to use it.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jodah meets Meria in Yavimaya, who declines to commit her troops to Shiv.
timeline.quote: But travel to Shiv? No, I think not.

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian dragon engine driven by Rona attacks Yavimaya, uprooting the Magnigoths.
timeline.quote: a dragon engine reared into Yavimaya's vacant blue skies.

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Meria finds a Thran artifact in the mud; Jodah portals them away and it creates a vacuum that kills the dragon engine's organic parts.
timeline.quote: The Thran weapon had created a spherical vacuum.

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Rona flees from the dragon engine, and Meria decides her people must fight.
timeline.quote: "Then there's only one path for us. And it doesn't lie in Yavimaya."

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: A Gorilla Chieftain has Laina and Kaysa brought to him and allies his people with the elves against the Heart of Yavimaya.
timeline.quote: he allied his people with the elves , and aided in the attack against the Heart of Yavimaya , which cleansed the forest

citation.text: "Ape", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yavimayan elves melt the frozen Phyrexian beasts with nature magic, causing them to collapse.
timeline.quote: used their nature magic to melt the frozen Phyrexian beasts, causing them to collapse

citation.text: "Battle of Kjeldor", section "The story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kjeldor survives and a bond is forged between Yavimaya and New Argive.
timeline.quote: a bond was forged between Yavimaya and New Argive

citation.text: "Battle of Kjeldor", section "The story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jaeuhl Carthalion and Kaysa lead Fyndhorn survivors to Yavimaya and make peace with Multani.
timeline.quote: led the Fyndhorn survivors to Yavimaya

citation.text: "Flooding of Terisiare", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Heart of Yavimaya grows near the Yavimaya River after the Sylex Blast, slowly forming the forest around it.
timeline.quote: The Heart of Yavimaya grew near the pre-existing Yavimaya River in the wake of the Sylex Blast

citation.text: "Heart of Yavimaya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kjeldor and Yavimaya destroy the Phyrexians and rout the cultists; a ritual restores the Thaw.
timeline.quote: a Yavimayan ritual permanently ended Rimewind's unnatural winter and restored the Thaw to its proper course

citation.text: "Heidar", section "The end of Heidar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rith, imprisoned in Nemata by the Numena, is freed first by Darigaaz.
timeline.quote: The primeval dragon Rith was originally imprisoned inside Nemata in Yavimaya by the Numena

citation.text: "Nemata", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rith escapes during the Second Phyrexian Invasion and Nemata wakes his fellow treefolk to recapture her.
timeline.quote: Rith's sudden escape during the Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria left Nemata furious

citation.text: "Nemata", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Fall of the Primevals, Rith is imprisoned inside the Magnigoth Treefolk Nemata by the green Numena.
timeline.quote: she was imprisoned inside the Magnigoth Treefolk Nemata in Yavimaya by the green Numena

citation.text: "Rith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rith is the first freed by Rhammidarigaaz after Tevesh Szat tells him of the Primevals; she dominates Darigaaz's mind to free all the primevals.
timeline.quote: she dominated Darigaaz's mind, convincing him to free all of the primevals regardless of the cost to mortal dragon lives

citation.text: "Rith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rith is freed again during the second Phyrexian Invasion when her psychic connection to her reincarnated brother reawakens her.
timeline.quote: when her psychic connection to her reincarnated brother reawakened her

citation.text: "Rith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rofellos is sent to Yavimaya and exchanges places with Multani as the voice of the forest.
timeline.quote: he exchanged places with Multani as the voice of Yavimaya

citation.text: "Rofellos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rofellos steps down as Yavimaya's avatar; Multani offers to teach him Maro-Sorcery.
timeline.quote: Rofellos stepped down

citation.text: "Rofellos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rofellos studies with Gerrard and Mirri under Multani, then joins the Weatherlight crew with Mirri.
timeline.quote: Rofellos and Mirri offered to come along as well

citation.text: "Rofellos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yavimaya saprolings drop from trees and burst open to rot Phyrexian zombies.
timeline.quote: They proved remarkably effective against undead during the Phyrexian Invasion

citation.text: "Saproling", section "Yavimaya". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: Multani's heart is a seed and all of Yavimaya its flower.
relations.quote: Multani's heart is a seed, and all of Yavimaya is its flower.

citation.text: Yavimaya, Cradle of Growth (Modern Horizons 2 Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

relations.quote: the central magnigoth tree of the Yavimaya Forest on Dominaria

citation.text: "Heart of Yavimaya". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.text: Masters Edition II: card flavor text (Masters Edition II, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: Land that lights the quickest path to battle.

citation.text: Duel Decks: Heroes vs. Monsters: card flavor text (Duel Decks: Heroes vs. Monsters, 2013), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A forest that is one being and awakens with Multani.

citation.text: Dominaria: card flavor text (Dominaria, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A thickly forested island where Karn and Multani are.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 8" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 May 2018.

pages_say.description: A forest region of Dominaria that the Weatherlight sails over.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

pages_say.description: The forest from which thallids originate, disturbed by Karn's dig.
